name: @guardbee/security-suite
description: Every GuardBee MCP security tool in one server: pick the groups or packages you want
long_description: One MCP server with the tools of the GuardBee packages you choose: a one-pass OWASP MCP Top 10 scan, secrets, prompt injection, toxic flows, MCP client configs, dependency CVEs by default, and code, supply-chain, network and platform groups on request (29 packages, 124 tools). Tool names carry their package's prefix (secrets_scan_text, injection_scan_text). No API key needed except for the platform group.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Groups or package ids, comma-separated: recommended, code, supply-chain, network, platform, all
